diagnosis: Account is on legacy_auth, so the account-wide API token reset flow applies. Customer should reset via Security tab; old token remains valid 24 hours for overlap.
reply: Thanks for reaching out! Since your account is on Legacy Auth, you can reset your API token yourself: open the Security tab and choose Reset token. Your previous token stays valid for 24 hours after the reset, which gives you a window to update your integration without downtime. Once you provide the new token to your vendor, they can swap it in. Let us know if you run into any issues.
